      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/04/anc-south-africa-local-elections-water-outages-power-cuts</link>
      <description><p>Party expected to get less than a third of the vote amid frustration over water outages and power cuts</p><p>The African National Congress is on course for a bruising result in South Africa’s local elections on Wednesday as voters go to the polls amid deep discontent over water outages, power cuts and crumbling infrastructure.</p><p>The former liberation movement, which Nelson Mandela led to power in 1994 at the end of apartheid as South Africa’s first black president, is still likely to be the largest party.       <title>The US-China trade war seems to have subsided – but the sense of calm is misleading</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/01/us-china-trade-war-trump-xi</link>
      <description><p>A truce has cooled the trade conflict, but neither country has done anything to limit the outbreak of new hostilities</p><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/donaldtrump">Donald Trump</a>’s trade wars have largely fallen off the headlines.
